gaps.sentence: They're building ___ new library near the town hall.
gaps.explanation: A new library — first mention; the town hall is the known one.

gaps.sentence: We reached ___ agreement after hours of negotiation.
gaps.explanation: 'Reach an agreement' — 'agreement' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
She put ___ money in the safe before leaving.
gaps.explanation: 'The money' and 'the safe' are specific in the situation.

gaps.sentence: He was offered ___ job in the human resources department.
gaps.explanation: 'A job' — first mention of one of many possible jobs. Note: 'in human resources' takes no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ water in this bottle tastes strange.
gaps.explanation: The of/in-phrase makes the noun definite: the water in this bottle.

gaps.sentence: They drove to ___ south of France for the summer.
gaps.explanation: 'By train' takes no article; 'the south of France' takes 'the' (compass areas).

gaps.sentence: ___ problem is that people don't recycle enough.
gaps.explanation: The problem (the one we are discussing); people in general takes no article.
